evidence.tone: Plain-spoken, specific, and calm. Avoid hype, superlatives and guarantees.

facts.text: Northstar Studio designs and builds brochure websites for small professional-service teams. No ecommerce or paid advertising service is included.
Studio website: $4,800 one-time. Up to five pages, two revision rounds, design and development. Delivery timing is agreed per project; no results or delivery-time guarantees are approved.
Approved contact email: hello@northstar.example. Replies within two business days.
No client testimonials, named client logos, customer counts, revenue uplift, awards or performance results have been approved for publication.
